description: Manage a project's data room of versioned files. Uploading creates a versioned file with content, content hash, denormalized metadata (access level, description, categories, tags, encryption metadata) and links it into the room; re-uploading by reference appends a new version. Entries can be listed, fetched by path, moved, removed, and have their metadata updated; missing targets are reported as failures. Every change appears in the project and global activity feeds newest-first.
